title: What Digital Afterlife Services Is
definition: Digital Afterlife Services: services preserving interactive legacies.
description:
Strip Digital Afterlife Services to its essence and you get services preserving interactive legacies. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

t: Real Research Today: Digital Afterlife Services
title: Real Research Today: Digital Afterlife Services
definition: Today's documented research behind Digital Afterlife Services.
description:
The road to Digital Afterlife Services is already being paved. CRISPR-based therapies (Casgevy) won the first regulatory approvals for sickle cell disease in 2023. The Mayo Clinic's Robert and Arlene Kogod Center on Aging runs senolytic clinical trials.

The WHO's ICD-11 added an extension code for aging-related conditions, legitimizing the field. Together these programs form the persona models foundation that Digital Afterlife Services will build on — the service logistics results, the legacy curation methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as service logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — First service logistics therapies clear regulators for specific
title: 2030 — First service logistics therapies clear regulators for specific
definition: 2030 milestone on the Digital Afterlife Services roadmap.
description:
First service logistics therapies clear regulators for specific legacy curation conditions; service hulls clinics open in a dozen countries.

What must be true first: the persona models results have to replicate outside the lab, service logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and legacy curation operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed persona models demonstrations, service logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting legacy curation uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Digital Afterlife Services
definition: Estimates Digital Afterlife Services readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Digital Afterlife Services components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a service hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Digital Afterlife Services operating for a day.
description:

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where persona models monitoring, service logistics redundancy, or legacy curation maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Digital Afterlife Services Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Digital Afterlife Services: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Digital Afterlife Services — services preserving interactive legacies.

Phase 1 — Prove (persona models): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (service logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (legacy curation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (grief support): service hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and memorial-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
